key.name: folder-preview-enabled
key.summary: Show previews on folder icons

key.name: folder-preview-layout
key.summary: Preview layout
key.description: grid = up to 4 photos on the folder's front face; stacked = a stack of up to 3 cards.

key.name: folder-preview-cycle
key.summary: Cycle through more photos while hovering

key.name: folder-preview-stack-step
key.summary: Photos per hover step in the stacked layout

key.name: folder-preview-border
key.summary: Draw a border around each photo

key.name: folder-preview-border-colour
key.summary: Photo border colour (#rrggbb)

key.name: folder-preview-shadow
key.summary: Draw a soft shadow under each photo

key.name: folder-preview-rotation
key.summary: Tilt each photo by a random (but stable) angle

key.name: folder-preview-keep-aspect
key.summary: Keep each picture's aspect ratio
key.description: false = pictures fill their section (grid) or card (stacked), cropped.

key.name: folder-preview-depth
key.summary: Depth effect in the stacked layout
key.description: Cards further back are blurred and darkened more.

key.name: folder-preview-folder-icon
key.summary: Custom folder icon (SVG path) for the stacked layout

key.name: folder-preview-overlay-icon
key.summary: Front overlay (SVG path) drawn over the stack in the stacked layout
key.description: Empty = none. Drawn at the same size and position as the folder icon (the whole icon square).

key.name: sidebar-drives-enabled
key.summary: Enhanced drive rows in the sidebar

key.name: bar-colour-mode
key.summary: Usage bar colour
key.description: accent = the GNOME accent colour; custom = bar-colour; gradient = bar-gradient-start to bar-gradient-end across the filled part.

key.name: bar-colour
key.summary: Custom usage bar colour (#rrggbb)

key.name: bar-gradient-start
key.summary: Gradient start colour (#rrggbb)

key.name: bar-gradient-end
key.summary: Gradient end colour (#rrggbb)

key.name: show-usage-bars
key.summary: Show usage bars on drive rows

key.name: show-size-labels
key.summary: Show the "free of" size labels on drive rows

key.name: eject-slide
key.summary: Slide the eject button in on hover or focus

key.name: folder-views-enabled
key.summary: Remember the view type and icon size per folder

key.name: folder-views-generation
key.summary: Folder views generation
key.description: Incremented by "Reset All Folder Views"; saved folder views with an older generation are ignored.

key.name: folder-views-default-view
key.summary: View type for folders without a saved view

key.name: folder-views-default-grid-zoom
key.summary: Grid icon size for folders without a saved view

key.name: folder-views-default-list-zoom
key.summary: List icon size for folders without a saved view

key.name: folder-views-defaults-captured
key.summary: Whether the folder views default was copied from Files' settings
key.description: Set once, the first time the feature runs (PLAN.md §10.1.1).
